title: The Raiders' Nest
text: The raids on the outer farms were never bandits. The bodies were eaten, not robbed. Tracks lead back through the Rift Gate to a den in the Beast Lands, and the beasts are learning the way, a little closer each moon. It has to be burned out this Year.

options.label: Strip the armories to arm the party.

outcomes.text: Every House gives up iron for spearheads, and the smiths work through the night.

options.label: Leave a herd out as bait to draw them.

outcomes.text: The beasts take the bait, and the den is half empty when the party comes.
The beasts take the bait, and the herd, and come back for more.

options.label: Bar the farms and wait for the party.

outcomes.text: The farmers sleep in the town square until it is done, and they do not sleep well.
